title: Why connectors beat plugins
body: A connector is one URL the user pastes. No install, no model bill. The host brings the model.

title: What a session token is for
body: It gates the real tools so the model must call begin_session first. It is an app-level handle, not a protocol session.

title: Identity from the subject
body: Read the user from the verified token's sub, never from a tool argument. That one rule prevents cross-user leaks.
